title: Preflight signal snapshot and activation cheatsheet
content:
Purpose:
Short, portable preflight for product activation windows — single-page cheat sheet for on-call, PM, and engineers to run a quick readiness pass, validate signals, and execute a small rollback/scale play if needed. Not a replacement for full launch playbook; this is a low-friction operational snapshot to use in the hour before traffic shifts.

Quick KPI snapshot (current values — paste from dashboard):
- active-requests-per-sec: 1800
- p95-latency-ms: 420
- error-rate-5m: 0.32%
- success-rate: 99.68%
- tokens-per-minute (ingress): 1.2M
- average-cost-per-1k-tokens: $0.87
- cache-hit-rate (prefix): 34%
- model-fallback-events (24h): 1

Activation signal thresholds (hard triggers):
- Latency: p95 > 650ms for 10m -> pause ramp, scale-up GPU pool or reduce concurrency.
- Errors: error-rate > 1.5% sustained 5m -> rollback to previous model variant and open incident channel.
- Cost: cost-per-1k-tokens > 2x baseline AND adoption < 15% of expected -> pause feature flag and re-evaluate batching/quantization.
- Regression: automated eval quality drop (BLEU/ROUGE/QA-F too low) by > 8% on golden prompt set -> revert model and notify ML lead.
- Downstream: queue-depth > 4x normal for 15m -> throttle non-critical routes and divert traffic.

Lightweight readiness checklist (tick off before traffic shift):
- [ ] Ownership and escalation: on-call SRE (Liam), PM owner (Aisha), ML owner (Mei), SE support (Ravi) — all paged and acknowledged
- [ ] Canary traffic: 1% baseline smoke traffic flowing to canary model for 30m with zero critical errors
- [ ] Metrics: p95, p50, error-rate, token-cost visible in console + dashboard links in channel
- [ ] Rollback tag: previous stable model pinned and tested for immediate failover (git tag/release id confirmed)
- [ ] Runbook snippets available in channel: command to switch traffic, circuit-breaker toggle, kill/unpause autoscaler
- [ ] Billing guardrails: daily spend cap set for feature route and finance alert configured
- [ ] Customer comms: support templated message ready if rollback required (channel: #cs-alerts)

Smoke tests (must pass on current canary):
- simple-generation: short prompt -> no hallucination flags, response length within expected bounds
- long-context: 2k token prefix -> KV cache warmed, no OOMs, p95 under threshold
- streaming: stream open -> tokens arrive within 200ms of upstream send
- embeddings job: 10-sample job -> embeddings stable and cosine similarity consistent with baseline

Traffic ramp plan (30 minutes window example):
- 0m: sanity checks done, all owners acked. open channel #activation-YYYYMMDD
- 5m: route 0.5% to canary, monitor 10m window
- 15m: if stable, 2% route -> monitor 10m window (low signal: p95, errors)
- 30m: 5% route -> validate KPIs and golden prompts
- 60m: continue geometric ramp (5x) only if no triggers. stop/rerun if any hard trigger fired.

Contingency play snippets (one-liners to paste in ops channel):
- failover to stable model: /infra/routing set-route --route product-feature --model stable-v2026-02-18
- throttle non-critical: /infra/routing set-route --route noncritical --weight 0
- pause Autoscaler: /infra/autoscale pause --pool feature-gpu-pool
- enable circuit-breaker: /infra/circuit open --route product-feature --threshold 0.01

Post-launch monitoring checklist (first 4 hours):
- 5m cadence: check errors & latency spikes in console (owner rotates every 30m)
- 1h cadence: quick audit of cost burn vs expected, token efficiency, cache hit trends
- 4h: golden prompt regression run and manual spot-check of customer-facing sessions
- 24h: roll-forward decision meeting if adoption meets KPI band or debrief and rollback if not

KPI acceptance bands (quick reference):
- p95 latency: pass if <=500ms, warn if 500-650ms, fail if >650ms
- error-rate: pass if <=0.5%, warn if 0.5-1.5%, fail >1.5%
- cost delta: pass if <= +20% expected, warn if +20-100%, fail if >100%
- quality regressions: pass if <= +/−4% on golden prompt evals, warn if 4-8%, fail if >8%

Escalation contacts and channels:
- primary SRE: Liam O'Connor (pager)
- ML lead: Mei Chen (slack + email)
- Product owner: Aisha Patel (slack)
- SE on-call: Ravi Kapoor (pager)
- slack channels: #activation-YYYYMMDD (ops), #cs-alerts (customer support), #infra-oncall

Notes / open questions / to-check before activation:
- Verify prefix cache TTLs vs expected traffic pattern (Mei)
- Confirm that canary uses same quantization profile as stable (Ravi)
- Quick smoke: confirm embedding vector mean/variance match baseline distribution (Liam)
- Finance: confirm daily cap has priority for this route before other campaigns (Aisha)

Postmortem hooks (if rollback):
- capture 30m of full traces + request samples and store in s3://launch-artifacts/activation-YYYYMMDD/
- run automated evals on all failing request ids against previous model and comment on PR that triggered rollout
- schedule 2-hour blameless postmortem within 48h with cross-functional attendees

Notes to self (quick):
- This doc intentionally minimal; keep it pinned in activation channel.
- If anything ambiguous during activation, default to pause traffic and revert to stable.

Revision history:
- 2026-02-20 Aisha created initial draft
- 2026-03-12 Liam updated contingency commands and thresholds

End of cheatsheet.
